entities.summary: Yoandy Leal Hidalgo is a volleyball player who plays as a wing-spiker for Turkish club Halkbank. Born in Cuba, he is a former member of the Cuban national volleyball team (2007–2010), and currently represents Brazil after gaining Brazilian citizenship in June 2015.
